name: tax_status_certificate
document_label: Mexican tax status certificate from the SAT (Constancia de Situación Fiscal)

fields.full_name: name of the taxpayer (nombre, denominación o razón social) as printed
fields.tax_regime: tax regime (régimen) as printed; if several, the first one
fields.street: street of the fiscal address (nombre de vialidad)
fields.issue_date: issue date (lugar y fecha de emisión), date only as printed
fields.taxpayer_status: status in the registry (estatus en el padrón), e.g. ACTIVO

extra_instructions: The certificate is issued by the SAT. The first page has the identification (RFC, CURP, name, idCIF) and the fiscal address; the regimes and obligations follow. issue_date is the date in 'Lugar y Fecha de Emisión', without the place. Copy RFC and CURP character by character. Do not take values from the QR code or the barcode.
